ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixels are concentrated in irregular mottling along the upper trailing edge and in numerous discrete annular (ring-shaped) clusters distributed across the central and lower dark regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 115 degrees; depth is roughly 20% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent serrations; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude is visible across the entire span, with higher frequency of sharper peaks on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a prominent concave sweep originating from the median notch and terminating at upward-pointing lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense population of approximately 30 distinct circular, high-contrast white rings (diameters ranging 5-20 pixels) scattered across the dark ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast linear pixel streaks visible in the lower central quadrant of the left lobe, oriented diagonally toward the fluke base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent high-intensity, calcified textured clusters are located on the distal-most lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct cluster of high-intensity pixels forms an irregular white patch at the trailing edge of the left lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch.
